title: WRITEQ TS with RESP: NOSUSPEND, MAIN, AUXILIARY, ITEM, NUMITEMS, REWRITE ITEM, and REWRITE answered ITEMERR / QIDERR

scenarios.summary: seven WRITEQ TS commands (NOSUSPEND write, ITEM + NUMITEMS, AUXILIARY, MAIN, REWRITE ITEM, REWRITE past the last item, REWRITE of an absent queue), each logged to HCLOG with ITEM, NUMITEMS and RESP
